A bit about me

Some context

I started web3 as a raider — making $15 a week and happy with that. Somewhere along the way I figured out something small to build, and kept building it. No agency, no team handed to me on day one — just spaces, timelines, and a lot of reps.

What else? I'm a community-first builder, always chasing the next alpha, and lately trying to understand DeFi well enough to build inside it, not just talk about it.
